title: Street
description: A street's cross-section, north to south, and what stands along it. Metres, and every one (tune): distances are set for play, not measured (D11).

lotDepth.label: Lot depth
lotDepth.description: Lots run south from the alley to here, where the buildings' fronts stand.

open.label: Open side
open.description: Across the street, the side nearest the camera, kept open so nothing hides the street (D32).

depth.description: The verge or car park beyond the sidewalk.

yards.description: Beyond the alley, the next street's yards; then its buildings, seen from the back.

run.description: Street past the lots at each end, so a pan never runs out of street.

lampEvery.label: A lamp every
lampEvery.description: Along each curb, the open side's offset by half.

trees.description: Trees on the open side, when it is a verge.
